description: A template outlining metadata to be collected and applied to fastq file entities as annotations in Synapse.

assay.description: The technology used to generate the data in this file. Select all assays that apply. e.g., the GEX fastq files from a CITE-seq experiment should be labeled with both 'scRNASeq' and 'CITESeq'.
assay.title: assay

fileFormat.description: Standard file format name or file extension
fileFormat.title: fileFormat

libraryID.description: A library label or name, unique within an experiment, used to distinguish sequencing libraries.
libraryID.title: libraryID

readLength.description: The number of base pairs (bp) sequenced for reads in a fastq file. If value unknown, enter '-1'
readLength.title: readLength

specimenModality.description: Label assigned to experimental data files indicating whether the data contained corresponds to a single or multiple biospecimens
specimenModality.title: specimenModality

title: FastqFileAnnotationTemplate
